title: Hotfix for the 0.4.7 demand crash
text: The 0.4.7 demand crash (T-4367) is fixed on master: every 0.4.7 player with intercity trips off (the iPad default) can hit 'Demand stopped' after making a new line, until they reload. Put it out now as a hotfix (0.4.7 plus that one fix, app only, no data change; I'd have one reviewer read the diff first), or wait for the next release? I'd do the hotfix.
